        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>98f58118f894082f113055ea738d6bc6</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "mine",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "6fab7dd278e415c8e5bdea665c89d8a5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-02",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-02 manager fixture",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "93eeda729062207211ec3270cbf1545e",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-02",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-02 unassigned fixture",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

sys_update_xml.payload: <unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00"> <sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <active>true</active> <copied_from /> <description>Agent row of the ACL matrix (AAP 0.5.6): create YES, read/write ASSIGNED ONLY, delete NO. "Assigned only" is exercised both ways - assigned_agent is the agent, and assigned_group contains the agent - plus the negative case of a case assigned to nobody. The negative WRITE is a genuine attempted write, not a query: step 8 attempts the update through GlideRecordSecure - the only scoped API that applies the write ACL - and asserts the stored row is unchanged. It is a script step rather than a native Record Update step because ATF's Record Update must first LOCATE the row, and the assigned-only read ACL already hides it from the agent, so that step aborts with "Unable to find record" instead of reaching an update-refused outcome. For this role read scope and write scope are the same set, so a case the agent can read but not write does not exist by design; the readable-row-with-forbidden-field case is covered by ATF 05.</description> <enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing> <fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error> <name>ATF 03 - RBAC: x_casemgmt_case_agent create, ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write, no delete</name> <parameters /> <sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=afd33eebe6f49b746316b620f3886027" /> <remember /> <sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated> <sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>afd33eebe6f49b746316b620f3886027</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>ATF 03 - RBAC: x_casemgmt_case_agent create, ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write, no delete</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy /> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_afd33eebe6f49b746316b620f3886027</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <test_origin>manual</test_origin> </sys_atf_test> </unload>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>2f639a629a79c983cd00391c9d368757</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>1a1edfbe06ca793bccb1510fd08f314a</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "agent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "42467a299b31d305bf03d85cf5882b9b",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 assigned to the agent",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ad0ebc37a39bcca71d91cf84d09d6243",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 group assignment only",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "nobody",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 assigned to nobody",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>
        <variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable>
    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>3c3ef25ced2dc93cd7ae4b0617e9f2ad</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>dfa640dc52da1a0c086076650c82d9c2</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }

    // WHY THIS STEP IS A SCRIPT AND NOT A NATIVE "Record Update" STEP.
    //
    // The obvious way to prove "the agent may not write an unassigned case" is a
    // native Record Update step with Enforce security = 1 and assert type
    // record_not_updated. That was tried and it CANNOT work here. Measured in the real
    // ATF client test runner, that step failed with:
    //
    //   FAILURE: Unable to find record 'ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5' in table
    //   'x_casemgmt_case'
    //
    // ATF's Record Update step must LOCATE the row before it can attempt a write and
    // observe a denial, and the assigned-only READ ACL has already made that row
    // invisible to the impersonated agent - which step 6 proves independently. Read
    // denial therefore precedes write denial: the platform never reaches an
    // "update refused" outcome for the step to assert on, and the step aborts instead.
    // The protection is STRONGER than the native step can express, not weaker.
    //
    // A TRAP THIS STEP DELIBERATELY AVOIDS. A plain GlideRecord does NOT enforce ACLs.
    // Measured on this instance while impersonating x_casemgmt_demo_agent: plain
    // GlideRecord.get() on the unassigned row returns true and canWrite() returns
    // false, yet update() still SUCCEEDS and leaves priority=High. A negative-write
    // proof must therefore never be built on plain GlideRecord.update() - it would
    // report a write the ACL layer was never asked about, and pass while the
    // protection was broken. Plain GlideRecord is used below only to READ the stored
    // value and to interrogate the platform's own per-record decisions.
    //
    // SCOPE NOTE (AAP Section 0.5.6). For x_casemgmt_case_agent the read scope and the
    // write scope are the same set - "Assigned only" - so a case row that the agent can
    // READ but must not WRITE does not exist by design. The record-level write refusal
    // is consequently enforced at the read gate, which is what this step asserts. The
    // separate case of a readable row with a forbidden FIELD (assigned_group,
    // assigned_agent) is covered by ATF 05.
    var UNASSIGNED = 'ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5';

    // The identity is asserted FIRST. Every denial below is only meaningful as the agent:
    // run as admin the same code would report canWrite=true and the secured write would
    // succeed, so without this the step could pass an unimpersonated run while proving
    // nothing. Measured: with step 2's Impersonate skipped, this assertion is what fails.
    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_agent', gs.getUserName());
    chkTrue('the caller holds x_casemgmt_case_agent', gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_agent'));
    chk('the caller does NOT hold x_casemgmt_case_manager', 'false',
        String(gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_manager')));

    // Baseline, read with a plain GlideRecord because the secured API cannot see it.
    var before = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the unassigned fixture exists to be attacked', before.get(UNASSIGNED));
    var priorityBefore = before.getValue('priority');
    chkTrue('the baseline priority was captured', String(priorityBefore || '').length > 0);
    chk('the fixture is genuinely unassigned to this agent - no assigned_agent',
        '', String(before.getValue('assigned_agent') || ''));
    chk('the fixture is genuinely unassigned to this agent - no assigned_group',
        '', String(before.getValue('assigned_group') || ''));

    // 1. The security-enforced API cannot even load the row.
    var sec = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chk('GlideRecordSecure.get cannot load the unassigned row', 'false',
        String(sec.get(UNASSIGNED)));

    // 2. Nor can a secured query iterate to it.
    var reachable = 0;
    var secQ = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    secQ.addQuery('sys_id', UNASSIGNED);
    secQ.query();
    while (secQ.next()) reachable++;
    chk('a secured query reaches zero rows for the unassigned sys_id', '0', String(reachable));

    // 3. The platform's own per-record decisions are all DENY.
    var probe = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('a plain GlideRecord can load the row, so the decisions below are real',
        probe.get(UNASSIGNED));
    chk('canRead is denied', 'false', String(probe.canRead()));
    chk('canWrite is denied', 'false', String(probe.canWrite()));
    chk('canDelete is denied', 'false', String(probe.canDelete()));

    // 4. A GENUINE security-enforced write ATTEMPT. GlideRecordSecure is the only
    //    scoped API that applies the write ACL, so the attempt is made through it and
    //    its outcome asserted - rather than querying and inferring a refusal.
    var attempted = 'no row reachable through the secured API';
    var secW = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    secW.addQuery('sys_id', UNASSIGNED);
    secW.query();
    if (secW.next()) {
        secW.setValue('priority', 'High');
        attempted = 'update() returned [' + secW.update() + ']';
    }
    chk('the secured write attempt could not modify the unassigned row',
        'no row reachable through the secured API', attempted);

    // 5. And the stored row is byte-for-byte unchanged afterwards.
    var after = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the row still exists after the refused write', after.get(UNASSIGNED));
    chk('priority is unchanged after the refused write', priorityBefore,
        after.getValue('priority'));

    stepResult.setOutputMessage('agent write on an unassigned case refused: secured get=false, ' +
        'secured query rows=' + reachable + ', canWrite=false, priority still [' +
        after.getValue('priority') + '] :: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'agent write on an unassigned case is refused', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);</value>
        <variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable>
    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>6078b78dd8e107baf5d4d191a224ded1</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>d1851c3ab3555a524cfb9e8597fc0b80</sys_id>

        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_agent', gs.getUserName());
    chkTrue('agent holds x_casemgmt_case_agent', gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_agent'));
    chk('agent does NOT hold x_casemgmt_case_manager', 'false', String(gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_manager')));
    var mine = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('agent can read its assigned case', mine.get('42467a299b31d305bf03d85cf5882b9b'));
    chkTrue('agent canCreate', mine.canCreate());
    chkTrue('agent canWrite its assigned case', mine.canWrite());
    chk('agent canDelete', 'false', String(mine.canDelete()));
    var byGroup = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('agent can read the group-assigned case', byGroup.get('ad0ebc37a39bcca71d91cf84d09d6243'));
    chkTrue('agent canWrite the group-assigned case', byGroup.canWrite());
    var theirs = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chk('agent cannot read a case assigned to nobody', 'false', String(theirs.get('ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5')));

    // WRITE DENIAL ON AN UNASSIGNED ROW, asserted as a per-record decision and as a
    // stored value. Step 8 genuinely attempts the update through GlideRecordSecure - the
    // only scoped API that applies the write ACL - and asserts the row was not modified;
    // this block proves WHY it cannot happen and that nothing changed underneath.
    //
    // Two earlier shapes of step 8 are recorded so neither is reintroduced. It began as a
    // Record Query with assert type no_records_match_query, which passes whatever the write
    // authorization is because it never attempted a write. It was then a native Record
    // Update with assert type record_not_updated, which cannot work either: that step type
    // must LOCATE the row before it can attempt the write, and the assigned-only read ACL
    // has already hidden it, so the step aborts with "Unable to find record" instead of
    // observing a denial - measured as a real suite failure before it was rebuilt.
    //
    // A plain GlideRecord is used deliberately: it loads the row WITHOUT applying the
    // read ACL (measured on this release), which is the only way to interrogate a row
    // the agent may not see. canRead/canWrite/canDelete on that loaded row are then the
    // platform's own per-record ACL decisions for the impersonated identity, not a
    // table-level guess. GlideRecordSecure cannot serve here because it refuses to load
    // the row at all, which would leave write authorization untested.
    var unassignedProbe = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the unassigned fixture still exists, so the denials below are about ACLs and not absence',
        unassignedProbe.get('ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5'));
    chk('agent canRead is FALSE for the unassigned case', 'false', String(unassignedProbe.canRead()));
    chk('agent canWrite is FALSE for the unassigned case', 'false', String(unassignedProbe.canWrite()));
    chk('agent canDelete is FALSE for the unassigned case', 'false', String(unassignedProbe.canDelete()));
    chk('the unassigned case still holds its original priority - step 8 changed nothing',
        'Medium', unassignedProbe.getValue('priority'));
    // And the secured path cannot even reach the row to attempt a write.
    var secureWrite = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    secureWrite.addQuery('sys_id', 'ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5');
    secureWrite.query();
    chk('a secured query cannot iterate to the unassigned row', 'false', String(secureWrite.next()));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('agent capability matrix and assigned-only narrowing: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'agent capability matrix and assigned-only narrowing', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>7e7bb08d9a54519d78f1d5f0e3f39771</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>8b60134d662913e0711a29c54fa68b74</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "agent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "42467a299b31d305bf03d85cf5882b9b",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 assigned to the agent",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ad0ebc37a39bcca71d91cf84d09d6243",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 group assignment only",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "nobody",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 assigned to nobody",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>7e054b9e0778b4cff2b63d15cec671db</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>055d9ff25e1be02487673e0a533b742a</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "other",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "cd17696587e11cb376a2964c217ff87f",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-04",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-04 assigned elsewhere",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>
        <variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable>
    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_viewer', gs.getUserName());
    chkTrue('viewer holds x_casemgmt_case_viewer', gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_viewer'));
    var probe = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('viewer canRead any case', probe.get('cd17696587e11cb376a2964c217ff87f'));
    chk('viewer canCreate', 'false', String(probe.canCreate()));
    chk('viewer canWrite', 'false', String(probe.canWrite()));
    chk('viewer canDelete', 'false', String(probe.canDelete()));
    // GlideRecordSecure.getRowCount() is NOT ACL-filtered - it reports the raw
    // database count - so ANY threshold assertion on it can pass while the role
    // sees nothing at all. Measured on this instance with 11 cases: the demo agent
    // (assigned-only) reported getRowCount()=11 while iteration yielded 9. The
    // visible set is therefore built by ITERATION and compared id-for-id against an
    // authoritative set read through a plain GlideRecord, which bypasses ACLs by
    // design and is the only trustworthy statement of what rows exist.
    function idsOf(gr) {
        var o = [];
        while (gr.next()) { o.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); }
        o.sort();
        return o;
    }
    var authoritative = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    authoritative.query();
    var everyId = idsOf(authoritative);
    var secureAll = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    secureAll.query();
    var visibleId = idsOf(secureAll);
    chk('viewer sees EVERY case (read all, exact set equality)',
        everyId.join(','), visibleId.join(','));
    chk('viewer visible-case count equals the stored row count',
        String(everyId.length), String(visibleId.length));
    chkTrue('the fixture the viewer has no relationship to is inside the visible set',
        visibleId.indexOf('cd17696587e11cb376a2964c217ff87f') > -1);
    chkTrue('the comparison is not being made over an almost-empty table (AAP 0.7.4 seeds 10+)',
        everyId.length >= 10);
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('viewer capability matrix: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'viewer capability matrix', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>82558845ba9599b972a1c56b7f085415</document_key>

        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>f6f6d431ca45e5bc713973d7e976b8a5</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "other",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "cd17696587e11cb376a2964c217ff87f",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-04",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-04 assigned elsewhere",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>e2e5a70cb4aeff0310c8f3f4f014b132</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>

        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "acl",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "174bb5a31631f5fb4f95c14083aa1afd",
            "prefix": "ATF-ACL-05",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-ACL-05 field level acl",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('manager can read the fixture', gr.get('174bb5a31631f5fb4f95c14083aa1afd'));
    chkTrue('manager may write assigned_group', gr.getElement('assigned_group').canWrite());
    chkTrue('manager may write assigned_agent', gr.getElement('assigned_agent').canWrite());
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('manager field-level write capability: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'manager field-level write capability', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>a762634f65908637d7752f1c22d4d8c2</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>f4f04dabc7fe8fee43f6616de0782f59</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "acl",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "174bb5a31631f5fb4f95c14083aa1afd",
            "prefix": "ATF-ACL-05",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-ACL-05 field level acl",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>18ba98057f2faa57db5477f347b4aa12</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>c381fb8f2f9dead8c4a581da3b95d741</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "parent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-06",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-06 parent case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "94a0371e5a4444df0b4fecab96375fde",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-06",
            "fields": {
                "case": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-06 task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "party",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "165fe5387948213f9b16f8ade71c0749",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {
                "case": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
                "party_type": "Person",
                "person": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "role_label": "Witness"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_viewer', gs.getUserName());
    var tk = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case_task');
    chkTrue('viewer canRead task', tk.get('94a0371e5a4444df0b4fecab96375fde'));
    chk('viewer canCreate task', 'false', String(tk.canCreate()));
    chk('viewer canWrite task', 'false', String(tk.canWrite()));
    chk('viewer canDelete task', 'false', String(tk.canDelete()));
    var pt = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case_party');
    chkTrue('viewer canRead party', pt.get('165fe5387948213f9b16f8ade71c0749'));
    chk('viewer canCreate party', 'false', String(pt.canCreate()));
    chk('viewer canWrite party', 'false', String(pt.canWrite()));
    chk('viewer canDelete party', 'false', String(pt.canDelete()));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('viewer capability matrix on the child tables: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'viewer capability matrix on the child tables', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "parent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-06",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-06 parent case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "94a0371e5a4444df0b4fecab96375fde",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-06",
            "fields": {
                "case": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-06 task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "party",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "165fe5387948213f9b16f8ade71c0749",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {
                "case": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
                "party_type": "Person",
                "person": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "role_label": "Witness"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

sys_update_xml.payload: <unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00"> <sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <active>true</active> <copied_from /> <description>The agent row of the ACL matrix on the child tables (AAP 0.5.6): an agent may read and write a task or party whose PARENT case is assigned to that agent, may create, and may never delete. "Assigned only" is a disjunction - assigned_agent = current user OR assigned_group contains current user - so five parent fixtures isolate it: both branches at once, direct-only, group-only, unassigned, and a group the agent is not a member of. Each parent carries one task and one party child, and every child is asserted for read, write and delete, so neither OR branch can pass on the strength of the other and a fail-open ACL cannot hide. This test previously ran RED because the four scripted child-table ACLs dereferenced the reserved word "case" as current.case, which the script engine refuses to compile ("missing name after . operator"), denying every row; those ACLs now read the parent through current.getElement('case') and the test is green.</description> <enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing> <fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error> <name>ATF 07 - RBAC: agent ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write on task and party (AAP 0.5.6 mirror)</name> <parameters /> <sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=e76510c28032c3279ae68fe31b6aa61d" /> <remember /> <sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated> <sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>e76510c28032c3279ae68fe31b6aa61d</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>ATF 07 - RBAC: agent ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write on task and party (AAP 0.5.6 mirror)</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy /> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_e76510c28032c3279ae68fe31b6aa61d</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <test_origin>manual</test_origin> </sys_atf_test> </unload>

    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
