                "case": "f7fb08a92f84b635e1118fbf871a97c5",
                "party_type": "Person",
                "person": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "role_label": "Witness"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "c12db6ba96650309f874e2245ad94102",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-07 parent assigned to NOBODY",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task-unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "255261c44d7e569393eb5b378f093cf5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {
                "case": "c12db6ba96650309f874e2245ad94102",
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-07 task on the unassigned parent",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "party-unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "84d0b2cec80ea74f5d3b34003cfb2629",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {
                "case": "c12db6ba96650309f874e2245ad94102",
                "party_type": "Person",
                "person": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "role_label": "Witness"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-othergroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "8e8ba999d36f28846a3a63a1889b0794",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-07 parent assigned to a group the agent is NOT in",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@nonmembergroup:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task-othergroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "d0d522c65c706fd4e973124487d5a306",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {
                "case": "8e8ba999d36f28846a3a63a1889b0794",
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-07 task on the othergroup parent",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "party-othergroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "1549f71e383e795314639032274605b9",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {
                "case": "8e8ba999d36f28846a3a63a1889b0794",
                "party_type": "Person",
                "person": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "role_label": "Witness"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        if (kind === 'nonmembergroup') { return nonMemberGroupId(key); }
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    chkTrue('a group the demo agent is NOT a member of was found for the negative branch',
        String(OTHER_GRP_ID).length === 32);
    var memberProbe = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
    memberProbe.addQuery('user', userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent'));
    memberProbe.addQuery('group', OTHER_GRP_ID);
    memberProbe.query();
    chk('the agent really is NOT a member of that group', '0', String(memberProbe.getRowCount()));
    var teamProbe = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
    teamProbe.addQuery('user', userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent'));
    teamProbe.addQuery('group', GRP_ID);
    teamProbe.query();
    chk('the demo agent IS a member of x_casemgmt_demo_team, so the positive group branch is real',
        '1', String(teamProbe.getRowCount()));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_agent', gs.getUserName());
    var parentId = 'ee66fab2aae0daab57a18a04fa5fc3bd';
    var parent = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('agent can read the parent case', parent.get(parentId));
    var tk = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case_task');
    chkTrue('agent can read a task on its assigned parent case', tk.get('ed02fff340bf0037625492f0cb259810'));
    if (tk.isValidRecord()) {
        chkTrue('agent canWrite that task', tk.canWrite());
        chk('agent canDelete that task', 'false', String(tk.canDelete()));
        chkTrue('agent canCreate tasks', tk.canCreate());
    }
    var pt = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case_party');
    chkTrue('agent can read a party on its assigned parent case', pt.get('41b752e01dd8d0f75ef3230a70b55d2c'));
    if (pt.isValidRecord()) {
        chkTrue('agent canWrite that party', pt.canWrite());
        chk('agent canDelete that party', 'false', String(pt.canDelete()));
        chkTrue('agent canCreate parties', pt.canCreate());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AAP 0.5.6 "Assigned only" is a DISJUNCTION on the parent case:
    //     assigned_agent = current user OR assigned_group contains current user
    // The fixture above satisfies BOTH halves at once, so on its own it cannot show
    // that either half works independently, and it cannot show the "only" at all.
    // The four parents below isolate each branch:
    //     direct      assigned_agent = the agent, assigned_group EMPTY   -> ALLOW
    //     group       assigned_group = the agent's team, no agent        -> ALLOW
    //     unassigned  neither field populated                            -> DENY
    //     othergroup  a group the agent is NOT a member of               -> DENY
    // Each carries its own task and party child, and each is asserted for read AND
    // write AND delete, so a fail-open ACL cannot hide behind the both-branch case.
    function childProbe(table, sysId) {
        var secure = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
        var visible = secure.get(sysId);
        // A plain GlideRecord loads the row without applying the read ACL (measured),
        // which is the only way to ask the platform for its per-record write and delete
        // decisions on a row the identity may not see.
        var plain = new GlideRecord(table);
        var exists = plain.get(sysId);
        return {
            visible: visible, exists: exists,
            canRead: exists ? plain.canRead() : null,
            canWrite: exists ? plain.canWrite() : null,
            canDelete: exists ? plain.canDelete() : null
        };
    }
    var ALLOW = [
        ['direct-assigned', 'x_casemgmt_case_task', '74896b49d2174d3fbf07b0f3c0e13cfb'],
        ['direct-assigned', 'x_casemgmt_case_party', 'e1655540ada67a5667dea0cc155f2d04'],
        ['group-assigned', 'x_casemgmt_case_task', 'f3573645a8f769471a11daeeb63a75b1'],
        ['group-assigned', 'x_casemgmt_case_party', 'd97f9690087d07b7e9a2633a357fbd28']
    ];
    var DENY = [
        ['unassigned-parent', 'x_casemgmt_case_task', '255261c44d7e569393eb5b378f093cf5'],
        ['unassigned-parent', 'x_casemgmt_case_party', '84d0b2cec80ea74f5d3b34003cfb2629'],
        ['nonmember-group-parent', 'x_casemgmt_case_task', 'd0d522c65c706fd4e973124487d5a306'],
        ['nonmember-group-parent', 'x_casemgmt_case_party', '1549f71e383e795314639032274605b9']
    ];
    var a, p;
    for (a = 0; a < ALLOW.length; a++) {
        var okCase = ALLOW[a], okName = okCase[0] + ' ' + okCase[1];
        p = childProbe(okCase[1], okCase[2]);
        chkTrue('fixture exists: ' + okName, p.exists);
        chkTrue('ALLOW read (' + okName + ')', p.visible);
        chkTrue('ALLOW canRead (' + okName + ')', p.canRead);
        chkTrue('ALLOW canWrite (' + okName + ')', p.canWrite);
        chk('DENY canDelete - the agent never deletes (' + okName + ')', 'false', String(p.canDelete));
    }
    for (var dn = 0; dn < DENY.length; dn++) {
        var noCase = DENY[dn], noName = noCase[0] + ' ' + noCase[1];
        p = childProbe(noCase[1], noCase[2]);
        chkTrue('fixture exists: ' + noName, p.exists);
        chk('DENY read (' + noName + ')', 'false', String(p.visible));
        chk('DENY canRead (' + noName + ')', 'false', String(p.canRead));
        chk('DENY canWrite (' + noName + ')', 'false', String(p.canWrite));
        chk('DENY canDelete (' + noName + ')', 'false', String(p.canDelete));
    }
    // Set-level narrowing: the allowed children must be inside the agent's visible
    // sets and the denied children must be outside them. GlideRecordSecure.getRowCount()
    // is NOT ACL-filtered, so the sets are built by iteration.
    function visibleIds(table) {
        var o = {}, g = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) { o[g.getUniqueValue()] = 1; }
        return o;
    }
    var visTask = visibleIds('x_casemgmt_case_task'), visParty = visibleIds('x_casemgmt_case_party');
    chkTrue('the direct-assigned task is in the visible task set', !!visTask['74896b49d2174d3fbf07b0f3c0e13cfb']);
    chkTrue('the group-assigned task is in the visible task set', !!visTask['f3573645a8f769471a11daeeb63a75b1']);
    chk('the unassigned-parent task is NOT in the visible task set', 'false',
        String(!!visTask['255261c44d7e569393eb5b378f093cf5']));
    chk('the nonmember-group task is NOT in the visible task set', 'false',
        String(!!visTask['d0d522c65c706fd4e973124487d5a306']));
    chkTrue('the direct-assigned party is in the visible party set', !!visParty['e1655540ada67a5667dea0cc155f2d04']);
    chkTrue('the group-assigned party is in the visible party set', !!visParty['d97f9690087d07b7e9a2633a357fbd28']);
    chk('the unassigned-parent party is NOT in the visible party set', 'false',
        String(!!visParty['84d0b2cec80ea74f5d3b34003cfb2629']));
    chk('the nonmember-group party is NOT in the visible party set', 'false',
        String(!!visParty['1549f71e383e795314639032274605b9']));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('agent assigned-only narrowing on the child tables: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'agent assigned-only narrowing on the child tables', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "parent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ee66fab2aae0daab57a18a04fa5fc3bd",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-07 parent case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "ed02fff340bf0037625492f0cb259810",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {
                "case": "ee66fab2aae0daab57a18a04fa5fc3bd",
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-07 task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "party",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "41b752e01dd8d0f75ef3230a70b55d2c",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {
                "case": "ee66fab2aae0daab57a18a04fa5fc3bd",
                "party_type": "Person",
                "person": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "role_label": "Witness"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-direct",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "bad75eb1c21c932236a5cd1a275fc83f",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "task-direct",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "74896b49d2174d3fbf07b0f3c0e13cfb",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "party-direct",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "e1655540ada67a5667dea0cc155f2d04",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "f7fb08a92f84b635e1118fbf871a97c5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "task-group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "f3573645a8f769471a11daeeb63a75b1",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "party-group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "d97f9690087d07b7e9a2633a357fbd28",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "c12db6ba96650309f874e2245ad94102",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "task-unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "255261c44d7e569393eb5b378f093cf5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "party-unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "84d0b2cec80ea74f5d3b34003cfb2629",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-othergroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "8e8ba999d36f28846a3a63a1889b0794",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "task-othergroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "d0d522c65c706fd4e973124487d5a306",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "party-othergroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "1549f71e383e795314639032274605b9",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {}
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>

        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "nogroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "83f3e6d3ff140821649d17368601a963",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-08",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-08 draft without a group",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>
        <variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable>
    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.get('83f3e6d3ff140821649d17368601a963');
    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    var withGroup = v.canTransitionToOpen(gr);
    chkTrue('canTransitionToOpen is true once assigned_group is set', withGroup.ok);
    gr.setValue('assigned_group', '');
    var without = v.canTransitionToOpen(gr);
    chk('canTransitionToOpen is false with no assigned_group', 'false', String(without.ok));
    chkTrue('a blocking message is supplied', String(without.error || '').length > 0);
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence line below was written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the value these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('validator message: [' + without.error + ']');
    notes.push('validator verdict for Draft to Open: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'validator verdict for Draft to Open', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>394419886dab25c08061380d73c8634b</document_key>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "nogroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "83f3e6d3ff140821649d17368601a963",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-08",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-08 draft without a group",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "d2b5064109ff252741f8c4c4d370b398",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-09",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-09 open without an agent",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);

        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.get('d2b5064109ff252741f8c4c4d370b398');
    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    chkTrue('canTransitionToInProgress is true for a member agent', v.canTransitionToInProgress(gr).ok);
    chkTrue('isAgentInGroup is true for the demo agent', v.isAgentInGroup(AGT_ID, GRP_ID));
    chk('isAgentInGroup is false for the demo viewer', 'false', String(v.isAgentInGroup(VWR_ID, GRP_ID)));
    gr.setValue('assigned_agent', '');
    var none = v.canTransitionToInProgress(gr);
    chk('canTransitionToInProgress is false with no agent', 'false', String(none.ok));
    chkTrue('a blocking message is supplied', String(none.error || '').length > 0);
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence line below was written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the value these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('validator message: [' + none.error + ']');
    notes.push('validator verdict and group-membership helper: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'validator verdict and group-membership helper', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>ef081ae374bb6d510b263fcf5bd04858</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>a707aec1eefb272324de7557185791c6</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "d2b5064109ff252741f8c4c4d370b398",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-09",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-09 open without an agent",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>ce1fc6a45238b1cc99760f242239c480</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>0334d1d7a1b77cab880399c3e5723225</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "wip",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "0e87e901adab05218fcbf7d5a84bc2c2",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-10",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-10 in progress case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('pending_reason choices', 'Awaiting Info,Awaiting Third Party,Other',
        choices('x_casemgmt_case','pending_reason').join(','));
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.get('0e87e901adab05218fcbf7d5a84bc2c2');
    chk('pending_reason is empty after returning to In Progress', '', gr.getValue('pending_reason') || '');
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('pending_reason choice set: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'pending_reason choice set', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>9c3c58ec9e0c2bb0065dd823a4a02e09</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>2e73844eafc1ca711f7ceb3e7b0291cb</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "wip",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "0e87e901adab05218fcbf7d5a84bc2c2",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-10",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-10 in progress case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "case",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-11",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-11 resolve gate case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "fe86c9e48b0f34254fd53ac38091d62b",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-11",
            "fields": {
                "case": "8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911",
                "subject": "ATF-SM-11 open child task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('fixture case readable', gr.get('8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911'));
    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    chk('open child task count', '1', String(v.getOpenTaskCountForCase('8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911')));
    var verdict = v.canTransitionToResolved(gr);
    chk('canTransitionToResolved is refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
    chk('blocking message is verbatim', 'All tasks must be closed before resolving this case.', String(verdict.error));
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence line below was written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the value these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('message: [' + verdict.error + ']');
    notes.push('verbatim task-closure message: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'verbatim task-closure message', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.get('8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911');
    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    chk('open child task count is now zero', '0', String(v.getOpenTaskCountForCase('8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911')));
    chkTrue('canTransitionToResolved is now allowed', v.canTransitionToResolved(gr).ok);
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('gate reopens once every task is Closed: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'gate reopens once every task is Closed', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>
        <variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable>
    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "case",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-11",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-11 resolve gate case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "fe86c9e48b0f34254fd53ac38091d62b",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-11",
            "fields": {
                "case": "8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911",
                "subject": "ATF-SM-11 open child task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "resolved",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "3b8f2498cffba6dd162a3d5c0e7d06e3",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-12",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-12 resolved case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Resolved",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>8e1e7d049a34ac7e15b83aff153f2124</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>c21390682c090c1091cd0a1a42334105</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.get('3b8f2498cffba6dd162a3d5c0e7d06e3');
    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    chk('the session really is the agent', 'x_casemgmt_demo_agent', gs.getUserName());
    chk('agent does not hold x_casemgmt_case_manager', 'false', String(gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_manager')));
    var asAgent = v.canTransitionToClosed(gr, AGT_ID);
    chk('canTransitionToClosed refused for the agent', 'false', String(asAgent.ok));
    chkTrue('a blocking message is supplied', String(asAgent.error || '').length > 0);
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence line below was written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the value these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('agent message: [' + asAgent.error + ']');
    notes.push('validator refuses a non-manager: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'validator refuses a non-manager', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>
