<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>fa85e7115d8e7c0b98feb36a8ddeaadf</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>f7e08a98a6176eba5647bbd12823c94a</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "resolved",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "3b8f2498cffba6dd162a3d5c0e7d06e3",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-12",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-12 resolved case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Resolved",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>aa792f649fe819a66363e7cbbe2d6516</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>1e7baabe67d07d8becd9b3493150e436</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "2c5e1c1b024c34d83ce0524539985203",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-13",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-13 open case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "wip",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "134fa9e9d8acc56cc113172b2535927f",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-13",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-13 in progress case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>eedd403477f607cbe4e1e8d4c4c7ba22</document_key>

        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>f460249a42a44c064abfcfd4192bf41b</sys_id>

        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    var FROM = ['Open', 'In Progress', 'Pending', 'Resolved'];
    for (var i = 0; i < FROM.length; i++) {
        var verdict = v.validateNoBacktransition(FROM[i], 'Draft');
        chk(FROM[i] + ' to Draft refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
        chk(FROM[i] + ' to Draft message is verbatim', 'Cases cannot be returned to Draft.', String(verdict.error));
    }
    chkTrue('Draft to Open is not treated as a backtransition', v.validateNoBacktransition('Draft','Open').ok);
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('verbatim no-backtransition message from every source status: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'verbatim no-backtransition message from every source status', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>efd206e53b09e2bacd2b72b9afcd3c49</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>8ab9d7c6f8747a6f036309e3da7f2a36</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "2c5e1c1b024c34d83ce0524539985203",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-13",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-13 open case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "wip",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "134fa9e9d8acc56cc113172b2535927f",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-13",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-13 in progress case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>b57565b62a726c52a4a9c9152cb98122</document_key>
        <order />

        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>361060a8b003630c8e4a3d8c1a5f20a6</sys_id>

        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "closed",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "3ed0fd4998aa5a461d089e574c504954",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-14",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-14 closed case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Closed",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>9f4287fcd61eac9075bf4463ee240ce3</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>82e77275dda42d85ef3635cf271830af</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    var TO = ['Draft', 'Open', 'In Progress', 'Pending', 'Resolved'];
    for (var i = 0; i < TO.length; i++) {
        var verdict = v.validateNoBacktransition('Closed', TO[i]);
        chk('Closed to ' + TO[i] + ' refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
        chk('Closed to ' + TO[i] + ' message is verbatim', 'Closed cases are terminal and cannot be modified.', String(verdict.error));
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('verbatim terminal-state message for every target status: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'verbatim terminal-state message for every target status', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>3d524e6a17210eb0945db129d273b6d0</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>95a3aaec15d21f01ef8bd3b3dc0659be</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "closed",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "3ed0fd4998aa5a461d089e574c504954",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-14",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-14 closed case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Closed",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

sys_update_xml.payload: <unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00"> <sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <active>true</active> <copied_from /> <description>Form-level companion to ATF 11 for the verbatim message "All tasks must be closed before resolving this case.". Runs in the ATF client test runner: the case form is opened, the status field is set and the form is submitted, so the block is exercised through the same UI path a user takes. AUTOMATED COVERAGE: the submit reaches the server, the stored row is proven unchanged, and step 7 asserts the blocking string CHARACTER-EXACTLY against the same fixture in the same transaction - so a missing or reworded message turns this test red. NOT AUTOMATED, BY FRAMEWORK LIMITATION: that the string is RENDERED on the form. ATF has no step type that can read the classic form error banner - its only text-on-page assertion is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets the Custom UI DOM rather than the platform form this test drives, and "Submit a Form" exposes only form_ui and assert_type inputs. The rendered wording is therefore a MANUAL observation: read it from the runner step-5 screenshot, per docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md. It is not counted as automated coverage anywhere.</description> <enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing> <fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error> <name>ATF 15 - Form: resolving a case with an open task is blocked on the form</name> <parameters /> <sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=b90847a8102f3e04bef26db08270b42c" /> <remember /> <sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated> <sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>b90847a8102f3e04bef26db08270b42c</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>ATF 15 - Form: resolving a case with an open task is blocked on the form</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy /> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_b90847a8102f3e04bef26db08270b42c</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <test_origin>manual</test_origin> </sys_atf_test> </unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>84a4ea6bb7ae771361df6a3548cec456</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>4effecf4787f0878036683337e8c6a94</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "case",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-15",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-15 resolve gate case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "920320ac7154793fc020936272624c5b",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-15",
            "fields": {
                "case": "79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782",
                "subject": "ATF-UI-15 open child task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    // GUARD FOR THE CLIENT HANDOFF (step 3, "Open an Existing Record").
    // That step does not read the row itself: the browser calls the platform's own
    // GLOBAL-scope Script Include TestExecutorAjax.validateFormParameters, which
    // resolves it with a plain GlideRecord. If this application's tables refuse
    // cross-scope reads, that lookup returns nothing and the step fails with
    // "Table 'x_casemgmt_case' does not have a record with id '...'" - which reads
    // like a missing fixture but is really a table access-policy problem. The five
    // boolean cross-scope columns on sys_db_object (ws_access, read_access,
    // create_access, update_access, delete_access) must be TRUE; see
    // ../tables/x_casemgmt_case.xml. Asserting the fixture is resolvable HERE turns
    // that misleading downstream failure into a precise one, and it also removes any
    // dependence on a row left behind by an earlier run.
    for (var g = 0; g < FIX.length; g++) {
        var reread = new GlideRecord(FIX[g].table);
        chkTrue('fixture ' + FIX[g].label + ' is resolvable by sys_id after insert (the client form step resolves it the same way)',
            reread.get(FIX[g].sys_id));
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>57a597fab6aace3bdba72ba7aa4db39f</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>511bc05699c59dd51548cbb6bb7a05c5</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "case",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-15",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-15 resolve gate case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "920320ac7154793fc020936272624c5b",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-15",
            "fields": {
                "case": "79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782",
                "subject": "ATF-UI-15 open child task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        }
    ];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // VERBATIM MESSAGE, asserted before the fixtures are removed.
    //
    // WHAT ATF CAN AND CANNOT SEE HERE. The submit in step 5 is refused by the
    // server and step 6 proves the stored row did not change, but ATF ships no step
    // type that can read the classic form's error banner: the only text-on-page
    // assertion in the framework is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets
    // the Custom UI DOM and not the platform form these tests drive, and the
    // "Submit a Form" step exposes only `form_ui` and `assert_type` inputs. So the
    // fact that the message is RENDERED is a MANUAL observation - see the runner's
    // step-5 screenshot and docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md - and is not claimed as
    // automated coverage anywhere.
    //
    // What IS automated is the string itself. Without the block below this test could
    // pass while the message was missing or reworded, because nothing it asserted
    // depended on the wording. Asserting the exact string here, in the same
    // transaction and against the same fixture the form just submitted, means a
    // missing or altered message turns this test RED.
    var gate = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the fixture case is still present for the message assertion',
        gate.get('79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782'));
    chk('the case is still In Progress, so the refused submit changed nothing',
        'In Progress', gate.getValue('status'));
    var validator = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    chk('the open child task is still open, so the gate is genuinely closed',
        '1', String(validator.getOpenTaskCountForCase('79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782')));
    var verdict = validator.canTransitionToResolved(gate);
    chk('the Resolved transition is refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
    chk('the blocking message is verbatim (AAP 0.7.4)',
        'All tasks must be closed before resolving this case.', String(verdict.error));
    // stepResult.setOutputMessage OVERWRITES the step's output on every call - it does
    // NOT append. Measured in the client runner: this step called it three times and
    // only the last line survived, so the message-assertion evidence below was written
    // and then silently discarded. Every line is therefore accumulated here and emitted
    // exactly once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = ['message asserted server-side: [' + verdict.error + ']'];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

sys_update_xml.payload: <unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00"> <sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <active>true</active> <copied_from /> <description>Form-level companion to ATF 13 for the verbatim message "Cases cannot be returned to Draft.". Runs in the ATF client test runner: the case form is opened, the status field is set and the form is submitted, so the block is exercised through the same UI path a user takes. AUTOMATED COVERAGE: the submit reaches the server, the stored row is proven unchanged, and step 7 asserts the blocking string CHARACTER-EXACTLY against the same fixture in the same transaction - so a missing or reworded message turns this test red. NOT AUTOMATED, BY FRAMEWORK LIMITATION: that the string is RENDERED on the form. ATF has no step type that can read the classic form error banner - its only text-on-page assertion is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets the Custom UI DOM rather than the platform form this test drives, and "Submit a Form" exposes only form_ui and assert_type inputs. The rendered wording is therefore a MANUAL observation: read it from the runner step-5 screenshot, per docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md. It is not counted as automated coverage anywhere.</description> <enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing> <fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error> <name>ATF 16 - Form: returning a case to Draft is blocked on the form</name> <parameters /> <sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=058f262dab9141adcb30c3bd61667a78" /> <remember /> <sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated> <sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>058f262dab9141adcb30c3bd61667a78</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>ATF 16 - Form: returning a case to Draft is blocked on the form</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy /> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_058f262dab9141adcb30c3bd61667a78</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <test_origin>manual</test_origin> </sys_atf_test> </unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>29e00872198b161f721a8f151f71887b</document_key>

        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "8245a6f0cd348d300927983d87085c9b",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-16",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-16 open case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    // GUARD FOR THE CLIENT HANDOFF (step 3, "Open an Existing Record").
    // That step does not read the row itself: the browser calls the platform's own
    // GLOBAL-scope Script Include TestExecutorAjax.validateFormParameters, which
    // resolves it with a plain GlideRecord. If this application's tables refuse
    // cross-scope reads, that lookup returns nothing and the step fails with
    // "Table 'x_casemgmt_case' does not have a record with id '...'" - which reads
    // like a missing fixture but is really a table access-policy problem. The five
    // boolean cross-scope columns on sys_db_object (ws_access, read_access,
    // create_access, update_access, delete_access) must be TRUE; see
    // ../tables/x_casemgmt_case.xml. Asserting the fixture is resolvable HERE turns
    // that misleading downstream failure into a precise one, and it also removes any
    // dependence on a row left behind by an earlier run.
    for (var g = 0; g < FIX.length; g++) {
        var reread = new GlideRecord(FIX[g].table);
        chkTrue('fixture ' + FIX[g].label + ' is resolvable by sys_id after insert (the client form step resolves it the same way)',
            reread.get(FIX[g].sys_id));
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "8245a6f0cd348d300927983d87085c9b",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-16",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-16 open case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        }
    ];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // VERBATIM MESSAGE, asserted before the fixtures are removed.
    //
    // WHAT ATF CAN AND CANNOT SEE HERE. The submit in step 5 is refused by the
    // server and step 6 proves the stored row did not change, but ATF ships no step
    // type that can read the classic form's error banner: the only text-on-page
    // assertion in the framework is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets
    // the Custom UI DOM and not the platform form these tests drive, and the
    // "Submit a Form" step exposes only `form_ui` and `assert_type` inputs. So the
    // fact that the message is RENDERED is a MANUAL observation - see the runner's
    // step-5 screenshot and docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md - and is not claimed as
    // automated coverage anywhere.
    //
    // What IS automated is the string itself. Without the block below this test could
    // pass while the message was missing or reworded, because nothing it asserted
    // depended on the wording. Asserting the exact string here, in the same
    // transaction and against the same fixture the form just submitted, means a
    // missing or altered message turns this test RED.
    var gate = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the fixture case is still present for the message assertion',
        gate.get('8245a6f0cd348d300927983d87085c9b'));
    chk('the case is still Open, so the refused submit changed nothing',
        'Open', gate.getValue('status'));
    var validator = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    var verdict = validator.validateNoBacktransition(gate.getValue('status'), 'Draft');
    chk('the backtransition to Draft is refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
    chk('the blocking message is verbatim (AAP 0.7.4)',
        'Cases cannot be returned to Draft.', String(verdict.error));
    // stepResult.setOutputMessage OVERWRITES the step's output on every call - it does
    // NOT append. Measured in the client runner: this step called it three times and
    // only the last line survived, so the message-assertion evidence below was written
    // and then silently discarded. Every line is therefore accumulated here and emitted
    // exactly once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = ['message asserted server-side: [' + verdict.error + ']'];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

AUTOMATED COVERAGE: the submit reaches the server, the stored row is proven unchanged, and step 7 asserts the blocking string CHARACTER-EXACTLY against the same fixture in the same transaction - so a missing or reworded message turns this test red. NOT AUTOMATED, BY FRAMEWORK LIMITATION: that the string is RENDERED on the form. The rendered wording is therefore a MANUAL observation: read it from the runner step-5 screenshot, per docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md.         <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "closed",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "518799bb2fe107d3647146a08b3af61d",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-17",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-17 closed case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Closed",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    // GUARD FOR THE CLIENT HANDOFF (step 3, "Open an Existing Record").
    // That step does not read the row itself: the browser calls the platform's own
    // GLOBAL-scope Script Include TestExecutorAjax.validateFormParameters, which
    // resolves it with a plain GlideRecord. If this application's tables refuse
    // cross-scope reads, that lookup returns nothing and the step fails with
    // "Table 'x_casemgmt_case' does not have a record with id '...'" - which reads
    // like a missing fixture but is really a table access-policy problem. The five
    // boolean cross-scope columns on sys_db_object (ws_access, read_access,
    // create_access, update_access, delete_access) must be TRUE; see
    // ../tables/x_casemgmt_case.xml. Asserting the fixture is resolvable HERE turns
    // that misleading downstream failure into a precise one, and it also removes any
    // dependence on a row left behind by an earlier run.
    for (var g = 0; g < FIX.length; g++) {
        var reread = new GlideRecord(FIX[g].table);
        chkTrue('fixture ' + FIX[g].label + ' is resolvable by sys_id after insert (the client form step resolves it the same way)',
            reread.get(FIX[g].sys_id));
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "closed",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "518799bb2fe107d3647146a08b3af61d",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-17",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-17 closed case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Closed",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // VERBATIM MESSAGE, asserted before the fixtures are removed.
    //
    // WHAT ATF CAN AND CANNOT SEE HERE. The submit in step 5 is refused by the
    // server and step 6 proves the stored row did not change, but ATF ships no step
    // type that can read the classic form's error banner: the only text-on-page
    // assertion in the framework is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets
    // the Custom UI DOM and not the platform form these tests drive, and the
    // "Submit a Form" step exposes only `form_ui` and `assert_type` inputs. So the
    // fact that the message is RENDERED is a MANUAL observation - see the runner's
    // step-5 screenshot and docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md - and is not claimed as
    // automated coverage anywhere.
    //
    // What IS automated is the string itself. Without the block below this test could
    // pass while the message was missing or reworded, because nothing it asserted
    // depended on the wording. Asserting the exact string here, in the same
    // transaction and against the same fixture the form just submitted, means a
    // missing or altered message turns this test RED.
    var gate = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the fixture case is still present for the message assertion',
        gate.get('518799bb2fe107d3647146a08b3af61d'));
    chk('the case is still Closed, so the refused submit changed nothing',
        'Closed', gate.getValue('status'));
    var validator = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    var verdict = validator.validateNoBacktransition(gate.getValue('status'), 'In Progress');
    chk('the transition out of Closed is refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
    chk('the blocking message is verbatim (AAP 0.7.4)',
        'Closed cases are terminal and cannot be modified.', String(verdict.error));
    // stepResult.setOutputMessage OVERWRITES the step's output on every call - it does
    // NOT append. Measured in the client runner: this step called it three times and
    // only the last line survived, so the message-assertion evidence below was written
    // and then silently discarded. Every line is therefore accumulated here and emitted
    // exactly once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = ['message asserted server-side: [' + verdict.error + ']'];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

sys_update_xml.payload: <unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00"> <sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <active>true</active> <copied_from /> <description>POST /api/x_casemgmt/case_submit with Content-Type application/json must answer HTTP 201 carrying the generated case number and the verbatim message "Your case has been submitted", and the created case must land with status Draft and a CASE0000001-format number. Steps 2-8 assert that contract through the ATF-instrumented Send REST Request - Inbound step, which carries no credentials: the platform serves it as guest, its response carries X-Is-Logged-In false and the row it creates is guest-owned, so the 201 contract is asserted on behalf of a genuinely unauthenticated caller - and because ATF instruments that step type the insert sits inside the rollback context, measured on 2026-08-08 when a run whose step 10 had been skipped still came back clean. That step type cannot vary its request, so step 9 covers the rest of the anonymous surface from a server-side script with no credentials, WITHOUT persisting anything: an unauthenticated POST whose payload the handler must reject comes back carrying the handler own verbatim validation message, which a 401 or 403 from the authenticator could never do; the case step 2 submitted is read back through the anonymous lookup endpoint and exposes only status, subject and opened_date; and a census proves neither of those calls persisted a case. An earlier design submitted a valid case from that script - an outbound call from a script is NOT ATF-instrumented, so the rollback reversed this test own cleanup delete and every run left one synthetic case behind.
