        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var old = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    old.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', 'ATF-PORTAL-18');
    old.query();
    var n = 0;
    while (old.next()) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); n++; }
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence line below was written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the value these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('pre-existing submissions removed=' + n);
    chk('pre-clean ran', 'true', 'true');
    notes.push('clear any earlier submission fixture: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'clear any earlier submission fixture', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    function anonCall(method, path, body) {
        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        r.setHttpMethod(method);
        r.setEndpoint(String(gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri')).replace(/\/$/, '') + path);
        r.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
        if (body) {
            r.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
            r.setRequestBody(body);
        }
        var resp = r.execute();
        return { status: String(resp.getStatusCode()), body: String(resp.getBody() || '') };
    }
    function envelope(raw) {
        try { return JSON.parse(raw).result || {}; } catch (e) { return {}; }
    }

    // THE ANONYMOUS DIMENSION, ASSERTED WITHOUT LEAVING ANYTHING BEHIND.
    //
    // Measured, not assumed: the Send REST Request - Inbound step in step 2 sends no
    // credentials unless a basic or mutual auth profile is configured on it, and none
    // is - so the platform serves that call as `guest`. Its response carries
    // X-Is-Logged-In: false and the row it creates is owned by guest. ATF instruments
    // that step type, so the row IS inside the rollback context: in the run captured
    // on 2026-08-08 the Rollback batch removed the submitted case even though step 10
    // had been skipped by an earlier failure. Steps 2-8 therefore already assert the
    // 201-with-a-number contract on behalf of an UNAUTHENTICATED caller, and the row
    // is cleaned up whether or not step 10 gets to run.
    //
    // What that step type cannot do is vary its request: its inputs are static
    // configuration, it cannot read a value produced earlier in the same run, and it
    // cannot be pointed at a second endpoint. This step covers the rest of the
    // anonymous surface with sn_ws.RESTMessageV2 and no credentials at all - and it
    // does so WITHOUT persisting anything.
    //
    // It used to POST a VALID submission here. The endpoint accepted it, and because
    // an outbound call made from a script is NOT ATF-instrumented, the row guest
    // created that way sat OUTSIDE the rollback context: this test's own cleanup
    // delete ran inside the ATF transaction, the rollback reversed that delete, and
    // every run left one publicly lookup-addressable synthetic case behind, which
    // repeat runs accumulated. A test may not leave mutated state behind, and no
    // teardown available to it runs after the rollback in its own transaction without
    // either holding credentials or adding a second anonymous write surface to the
    // application. So the assertions below are non-mutating:
    //
    //   1. An unauthenticated POST carrying a body the handler MUST reject. A 401 or
    //      403 would come from the authenticator, ahead of the handler, so the
    //      handler's own verbatim validation message coming back proves both that the
    //      endpoint serves an anonymous caller and that its validation perimeter runs
    //      for one. A JSON array is the body used, because submitCase() rejects any
    //      non-object payload before it touches GlideRecord - see
    //      ../script_includes/x_casemgmt_CasePortalService.xml - so nothing can be
    //      written. The alternatives were measured and rejected: a bare string, a
    //      number or unparseable text is refused by the platform's body parser with
    //      HTTP 500 BEFORE the operation script runs, proving nothing about the
    //      handler, and an EMPTY body parses to no payload at all, which this
    //      endpoint accepts - it WOULD create a row.
    //   2. The case step 2 submitted, read back through the anonymous lookup endpoint
    //      with no credentials: the portal round trip is reachable end to end by an
    //      unauthenticated caller, and the three-field whitelist holds for one.
    //   3. Proof that neither call made HERE persisted a row. Every credential-free
    //      call runs as guest, so a row caused here would be guest-owned. The census
    //      opens after step 2's row exists and excludes that row by sys_id, so it can
    //      only catch a row these two calls created, and it stays valid on an
    //      instance other work is also using. The two-second backdate absorbs clock
    //      skew between this script and the sys_created_on the database stamps.
    var submitted = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    submitted.addQuery('subject', 'ATF-PORTAL-18 anonymous submission');
    submitted.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    submitted.setLimit(1);
    submitted.query();
    chkTrue('the case submitted in step 2 is readable', submitted.next());
    var submittedId = submitted.getUniqueValue();
    var submittedNumber = String(submitted.getValue('number'));
    chk('the submission step 2 made was itself served with no credentials, as guest',
        'guest', String(submitted.getValue('sys_created_by')));

    var sinceGdt = new GlideDateTime();
    sinceGdt.addSeconds(-2);
    var since = sinceGdt.getValue();

    var res = anonCall('post', '/api/x_casemgmt/case_submit', '[]');
    chkTrue('the unauthenticated submit was not challenged for credentials', res.status !== '401');
    chkTrue('the unauthenticated submit was not refused by authorization', res.status !== '403');
    chk('the unauthenticated submit reached the handler, which rejected the payload', '400', res.status);
    chk('the handler answered the anonymous caller with its own verbatim validation message',
        'Invalid payload.', String(envelope(res.body).error));

    var look = anonCall('get', '/api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup?number=' +
        encodeURIComponent(submittedNumber), null);
    chk('an unauthenticated caller can look that submitted case up', '200', look.status);
    var seen = envelope(look.body);
    chk('the anonymous lookup exposes EXACTLY the three whitelisted keys',
        'opened_date,status,subject', Object.keys(seen).sort().join(','));
    chk('the anonymous lookup returns the stored status', 'Draft', String(seen.status));
    chk('the anonymous lookup returns the stored subject', 'ATF-PORTAL-18 anonymous submission',
        String(seen.subject));
    chk('the anonymous lookup returns the stored opened_date character for character',
        submitted.getValue('opened_date'), String(seen.opened_date));

    var guestRows = [];
    var guestGr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    guestGr.addQuery('sys_created_by', 'guest');
    guestGr.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', since);
    guestGr.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', submittedId);
    guestGr.query();
    while (guestGr.next())
        guestRows.push(guestGr.getUniqueValue() + ' [' + guestGr.getValue('number') + ']');
    chk('neither call in this step persisted a case', '', guestRows.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence lines below were written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the values these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('step 2 submitted ' + submittedNumber + ' [' + submittedId + '] as ' +
        submitted.getValue('sys_created_by'));
    notes.push('anonymous POST [] -> ' + res.status + ' ' + res.body);
    notes.push('anonymous GET ' + submittedNumber + ' -> ' + look.status + ' ' + look.body);
    notes.push('further guest-owned cases created since ' + since + '=' + guestRows.length +
        (guestRows.length ? ' [' + guestRows.join(' ') + ']' : ''));
    notes.push('genuinely anonymous, non-mutating portal probe: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'genuinely anonymous, non-mutating portal probe', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>6d6dc143abdd34d4073bf18706ea49c5</document_key>

        <sys_id>d8c096f06d23c4d82533e736dc685721</sys_id>

        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED - AND THERE IS NO LONGER AN EXCEPTION.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology that passed even if every delete had
    // failed. What follows checks the outcome of each delete and then re-queries.
    //
    // It also used to carry a disclosed exception: step 9 submitted a real case
    // anonymously with sn_ws.RESTMessageV2, and an outbound call made from a script
    // is NOT ATF-instrumented, so that row - inserted by `guest`, over HTTP, in its
    // own transaction - sat OUTSIDE the transaction ATF wraps this test in. The
    // deletes below run INSIDE that transaction, so the ATF rollback reversed them
    // and the guest-created row reappeared after every run.
    //
    // Step 9 no longer submits anonymously; it proves the same anonymous perimeter
    // without persisting anything. The ONLY row this test now creates is the one
    // step 2 submits through the ATF-instrumented Send REST Request - Inbound step.
    // That request is itself served as `guest` - it carries no credentials, and its
    // response carries X-Is-Logged-In: false - but ATF instruments the step, so the
    // insert IS inside the rollback context. Measured on 2026-08-08: a run whose
    // step 10 was skipped by an earlier failure still came back clean, the Rollback
    // batch having removed the submitted case on its own. Deleting it here takes
    // effect, and the rollback then nets that insert and this delete to nothing.
    // Creator identity is therefore NOT a residue signal any more - both the old
    // leaked row and today's rolled-back row are guest-owned - so what is reported
    // below is who created each row, and what is asserted is the outcome:
    //   1. every delete this step issues reports success; and
    //   2. a re-query immediately afterwards finds zero rows.
    //
    // One historical caveat, stated rather than hidden: a row left on the instance
    // by a run of the PREVIOUS design is deleted by step 1, and the rollback - which
    // reverses deletions of rows that pre-dated the test - reinstates it. Such rows
    // must be swept once, by hand; runs of this design leave none.
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', 'ATF-PORTAL-18');
    gr.query();
    var n = 0, failedDeletes = [], deletedIds = [];
    while (gr.next()) {
        var rowId = gr.getUniqueValue();
        var createdBy = String(gr.getValue('sys_created_by'));
        gr.setWorkflow(false);
        if (gr.deleteRecord())
            { n++; deletedIds.push(rowId + ' [' + gr.getValue('number') + '] created by ' + createdBy); }
        else failedDeletes.push(rowId);
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    var residue = [];
    var after = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    after.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', 'ATF-PORTAL-18');
    after.query();
    while (after.next())
        residue.push(after.getUniqueValue() + ' [' + after.getValue('subject') + ']');
    chk('no ATF-PORTAL-18 row survives this test', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported line is
    // accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('submissions removed=' + n +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('removed=' + (deletedIds.join(' ; ') || 'none'));
    notes.push('remove the submitted case: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'remove the submitted case', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);</value>

sys_update_xml.payload: <unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00"> <sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <active>true</active> <copied_from /> <description>GET /api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup?number=<valid> must answer HTTP 200 with exactly the three whitelisted keys. The whitelist is asserted negatively as well: the body must not contain assigned_group, assigned_agent, description, closed_date, requester_name, requester_email, sys_id. The call is made with no credentials at all. Each returned value is compared to the stored value exactly - status, subject AND opened_date - so a response carrying a different case's data, a placeholder or a reformatted date fails. Because lookupCase() resolves the number with setLimit(1) and no orderBy, step 1 also VERIFIES that exactly one row carries the pinned number CASE9000019 and that the row is its own fixture, so the lookup cannot resolve to a foreign record. Verification, never enforcement by deletion: a row this test does not own - one carrying that number, or occupying the fixture sys_id without this test subject marker - fails the test, is named in the failure message and is left exactly as it was found.</description> <enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing> <fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error> <name>ATF 19 - Portal contract: lookup of a valid number returns only status, subject, opened_date</name> <parameters /> <sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=6e0aaff769e10fa94776c9722f94aa7b" /> <remember /> <sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated> <sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>6e0aaff769e10fa94776c9722f94aa7b</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>ATF 19 - Portal contract: lookup of a valid number returns only status, subject, opened_date</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy /> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_6e0aaff769e10fa94776c9722f94aa7b</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <test_origin>manual</test_origin> </sys_atf_test> </unload>

    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "lookup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "07c9b35d04dc04336b72fa1a9c011e11",
            "prefix": "ATF-PORTAL-19",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-PORTAL-19 lookup fixture",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "number": "CASE9000019",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    // A ROW IS DELETED ONLY WHEN IT IS PROVABLY THIS TEST'S OWN, AND A COLLISION IS
    // A FAILURE RATHER THAN SOMETHING TO CLEAR OUT OF THE WAY.
    //
    // Two independent things must hold before this step deletes anything: the row
    // must sit at the fixture's DETERMINISTIC sys_id - md5-derived, so a rebuild
    // converges on the same slot - AND it must carry this test's provenance marker,
    // a subject starting with the fixture's declared prefix, which is a string only
    // this test ever writes. A row occupying the slot without the marker is not
    // ours: it is named and left exactly as it was found.
    //
    // PINNED-NUMBER UNIQUENESS. This test pins number=CASE9000019 so the later
    // steps can drive the lookup with a known key. The endpoint resolves that key
    // with addQuery('number', trimmed).setLimit(1) and NO orderBy - see lookupCase()
    // in ../script_includes/x_casemgmt_CasePortalService.xml - so if a SECOND row
    // ever carried the same number, which row the lookup returned would be
    // non-deterministic: this test could then assert against a foreign record, or
    // pass while the contract was genuinely broken.
    //
    // This step used to DELETE every other carrier of the pinned number, whatever
    // its sys_id - including, by its own admission, a hand-made or imported row. A
    // test must never destroy data it does not own: the loss lasted only as long as
    // the ATF rollback took to restore it, and a failed or nonstandard run made it
    // permanent. A collision now FAILS this step instead, naming every offending
    // row, and nothing is deleted, inserted or updated - the instance is left
    // exactly as it was found, for a human to adjudicate.
    //
    // The pinned number is deliberately out of sequence: the generator mints
    // CASE0000001 upward with 7-digit padding, so it would take nine million cases
    // to reach CASE9000019. A carrier this test did not create can therefore never
    // be something a run of it caused - it is foreign data, and stopping is the only
    // safe response. A unique per-run key would side-step the question entirely, but
    // step 3 feeds the number to a Send REST Request - Inbound step whose query
    // parameters are static configuration, so the key has to be known before the run
    // starts (see F11 in ../docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md).
    var PINNED_NUMBER = FIX[0].fields.number;
    var foreignSlots = [], strayCarriers = [];
    for (var s = 0; s < FIX.length; s++) {
        var slot = new GlideRecord(FIX[s].table);
        if (!slot.get(FIX[s].sys_id)) { continue; }
        var slotSubject = String(slot.getValue('subject') || '');
        if (FIX[s].prefix && slotSubject.indexOf(FIX[s].prefix) !== 0)
            foreignSlots.push(FIX[s].table + ':' + FIX[s].sys_id + ' [subject=' + slotSubject +
                ' created by ' + slot.getValue('sys_created_by') + ']');
    }
    var stray = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    stray.addQuery('number', PINNED_NUMBER);
    stray.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', FIX[0].sys_id);
    stray.query();
    while (stray.next())
        strayCarriers.push(stray.getUniqueValue() + ' [subject=' + stray.getValue('subject') +
            ' created by ' + stray.getValue('sys_created_by') + ']');
    chk('no foreign row occupies a fixture slot', '', foreignSlots.join(' | '));
    chk('no foreign row already carries the pinned lookup number ' + PINNED_NUMBER, '',
        strayCarriers.join(' | '));

    // Stop before touching anything: inserting the fixture on top of a second carrier
    // of the pinned number would deepen the ambiguity, and every later step would then
    // assert against a row nobody can identify.
    if (foreignSlots.length || strayCarriers.length) {
        stepResult.setOutputMessage([
            'REFUSING TO RUN - nothing was deleted, inserted or updated.',
            'fixture slots held by foreign data=' + foreignSlots.length +
                (foreignSlots.length ? ' :: ' + foreignSlots.join(' | ') : ''),
            'foreign rows carrying ' + PINNED_NUMBER + '=' + strayCarriers.length +
                (strayCarriers.length ? ' :: ' + strayCarriers.join(' | ') : ''),
            'This test owns exactly one row: sys_id ' + FIX[0].sys_id + ', carrying a subject' +
                ' that starts with ' + FIX[0].prefix + '. Adjudicate the rows above by hand.',
            'fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length + ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ')
        ].join('\n'));
        return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
    }

    var replaced = 0;
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) replaced++;
        }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }

    // The pinned number must have SURVIVED the insert. `number` is auto-numbered, so
    // an explicit value can only be trusted once it has been read back from the
    // stored row - a business rule or the number generator overwriting it would
    // otherwise silently redirect every later step to a different case.
    var stored = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the fixture row is readable after insert', stored.get(FIX[0].sys_id));
    chk('the pinned lookup number was stored verbatim', PINNED_NUMBER, stored.getValue('number'));

    // Exactly ONE row may carry the pinned number, and it must be this fixture.
    // Counted by iteration rather than getRowCount() so the assertion names the
    // offending sys_id when it fails.
    var carriers = [];
    var carrier = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    carrier.addQuery('number', PINNED_NUMBER);
    carrier.query();
    while (carrier.next()) carriers.push(carrier.getUniqueValue());
    chk('exactly one case carries the pinned lookup number ' + PINNED_NUMBER, '1',
        String(carriers.length));
    chk('and the sole carrier of ' + PINNED_NUMBER + ' is this test\'s fixture',
        FIX[0].sys_id, carriers.join(','));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported line is
    // accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('foreign rows carrying ' + PINNED_NUMBER + ' found=' + strayCarriers.length +
        ' | fixture slots held by foreign data=' + foreignSlots.length +
        ' | own fixture rows replaced=' + replaced);
    notes.push('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>f95588a937f8fa5af17efdbe9e0f0560</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>f3139adedee47bdddb2e7fbfa6a10aff</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    function anonCall(method, path, body) {
        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        r.setHttpMethod(method);
        r.setEndpoint(String(gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri')).replace(/\/$/, '') + path);
        r.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
        if (body) {
            r.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
            r.setRequestBody(body);
        }
        var resp = r.execute();
        return { status: String(resp.getStatusCode()), body: String(resp.getBody() || '') };
    }

    var fixture = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('fixture readable', fixture.get('07c9b35d04dc04336b72fa1a9c011e11'));
    var number = fixture.getValue('number');
    chkTrue('fixture number matches the CASE0000001 format', /^CASE[0-9]{7}$/.test(number));
    var res = anonCall('get', '/api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup?number=' + encodeURIComponent(number), null);
    chk('anonymous lookup status', '200', res.status);
    var body = JSON.parse(res.body).result;
    var keys = Object.keys(body).sort();
    chk('the response carries EXACTLY the three whitelisted keys', 'opened_date,status,subject', keys.join(','));
    chk('status is the stored status', fixture.getValue('status'), String(body.status));
    chk('subject is the stored subject', fixture.getValue('subject'), String(body.subject));
    // F7 - EXACT VALUE, not merely "populated". lookupCase() returns
    // String(caseGr.getValue('opened_date') || '') - see
    // ../script_includes/x_casemgmt_CasePortalService.xml - i.e. the RAW stored
    // internal datetime, with no display-timezone conversion and no reformatting.
    // Stored value and returned value are therefore directly comparable as strings
    // and NO normalisation is applied to either side of the comparison below.
    // A "populated" check would have passed on any non-empty string - another case's
    // date, a placeholder, a display-formatted value - which is exactly what the
    // portal contract in AAP Section 0.7.4 requires this test to exclude.
    var storedOpened = fixture.getValue('opened_date');
    chkTrue('the fixture has a stored opened_date to compare against',
        String(storedOpened || '').length > 0);
    chk('opened_date is EXACTLY the stored opened_date, character for character',
        storedOpened, String(body.opened_date));
    chkTrue('the returned opened_date is an internal-format datetime (YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss)',
        /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$/.test(String(body.opened_date)));
    var FORBIDDEN = ["assigned_group", "assigned_agent", "description", "closed_date", "requester_name", "requester_email", "sys_id"];
    for (var i = 0; i < FORBIDDEN.length; i++) {
        chk('key ' + FORBIDDEN[i] + ' is absent from the parsed body', 'false',
            String(body.hasOwnProperty(FORBIDDEN[i])));
        chk('token ' + FORBIDDEN[i] + ' is absent from the raw body', '-1',
            String(res.body.indexOf(FORBIDDEN[i])));
    }
    chk('the assigned agent sys_id does not leak', '-1', String(res.body.indexOf(fixture.getValue('assigned_agent'))));
    chk('the case sys_id does not leak', '-1', String(res.body.indexOf(fixture.getUniqueValue())));
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends: emitted separately, the
    // response-body evidence below was written and then silently discarded, so the
    // run output never showed the payload these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('anonymous 200 body: ' + res.body);
    notes.push('opened_date compared exactly: stored[' + storedOpened + '] returned[' + String(body.opened_date) + ']');
    notes.push('anonymous lookup of a valid number and the field whitelist: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'anonymous lookup of a valid number and the field whitelist', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>0b77e1582f682491200db29943f5565f</document_key>
        <order />
        <sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name>
        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>c1456ad8a2473365c2a2754780dce86f</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "lookup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "07c9b35d04dc04336b72fa1a9c011e11",
            "prefix": "ATF-PORTAL-19",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-PORTAL-19 lookup fixture",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "number": "CASE9000019",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    //
    // OWNERSHIP, NOT JUST THE SLOT. The pinned sys_id on its own is not proof of
    // ownership: a row occupying that slot must ALSO carry this test's provenance
    // marker - a subject starting with the fixture's declared prefix - before it is
    // deleted. One that does not is named and left exactly as it was found, and this
    // step fails: cleanup never destroys data this test did not create.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [], foreignSlots = {}, foreignReport = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (!old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { continue; }
        var slotSubject = String(old.getValue('subject') || '');
        if (FIX[d].prefix && slotSubject.indexOf(FIX[d].prefix) !== 0) {
            foreignSlots[FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id] = true;
            foreignReport.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id + ' [subject=' + slotSubject +
                ' created by ' + old.getValue('sys_created_by') + ']');
            continue;
        }
        old.setWorkflow(false);
        if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
        else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));
    chk('no foreign row occupied a fixture slot', '', foreignReport.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id) && !foreignSlots[FIX[q].table + ':' + FIX[q].sys_id])
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | fixture slots held by foreign data=' + foreignReport.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>

    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>

<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00">
    <sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <document>sys_atf_step</document>
        <document_key>06ce956d311e524e0606f3c64ccb499f</document_key>
        <order />

        <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>
        <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on>
        <sys_id>deaa9222b64d4d9c39a4c0c963a2a0a2</sys_id>
        <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count>
        <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by>
        <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on>
        <value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    function anonCall(method, path, body) {
        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        r.setHttpMethod(method);
        r.setEndpoint(String(gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri')).replace(/\/$/, '') + path);
        r.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
        if (body) {
            r.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
            r.setRequestBody(body);
        }
        var resp = r.execute();
        return { status: String(resp.getStatusCode()), body: String(resp.getBody() || '') };
    }

    var res = anonCall('get', '/api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup?number=CASE9999999', null);
    chk('anonymous lookup status', '404', res.status);
    var body = JSON.parse(res.body).result;
    chk('the error message is verbatim', 'No case found with that number.', String(body.error));
    chk('the 404 body carries only the error key', 'error', Object.keys(body).sort().join(','));
    var empty = anonCall('get', '/api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup', null);
    chk('a missing number parameter also answers 404', '404', empty.status);
    chk('the empty-parameter message is verbatim', 'No case found with that number.', String(JSON.parse(empty.body).result.error));
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence line below was written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the value these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('anonymous 404 body: ' + res.body);
    notes.push('genuinely anonymous 404 with no credentials: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'genuinely anonymous 404 with no credentials', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value>
        <variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable>
    </sys_variable_value>
</unload>
